thread:
Wanda: quick doc PR question — legal flagged the phrase 'we are SOC2 compliant' as risky. proposing: 'Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 criteria and undergoes independent third-party assessment.' also want to add a short ops-facing example showing audit-event pseudonymization and a CLI export example for evidence requests. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1402

Omar: agreed on wording. for the example, engineers asked for both a streaming ingest example (TTL header) and a small before/after pseudonymization sample. keep both tiny.

Wanda: dropped drafts in the PR and copying here. BEFORE:
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2026_09_01_01",
  "user": { "id": "user_77", "email": "mike@acme.com" },
  "action": "session.start",
  "ts": "2026-09-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```
AFTER (pseudonymized):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2026_09_01_01",
  "user": { "id": "pseud_usr_7f3a", "email": "REDACTED" },
  "action": "session.start",
  "ts": "2026-09-01T12:00:00Z",
  "pseudonymized": "true"
}
```
CLI export example (ops):
```bash
# request historical audit export (JSONL) with pseudonymization option
redwood-cli audit export --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-08-31 --pseudonymize --format jsonl --output /tmp/audit-export.jsonl
```
SDK snippet (python, pseudo):
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
c = AuditClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
# set retention on a per-event basis
c.ingest(
  {"event_type":"token.rotate"},
  retention_ttl="180d",
  pseudonymize_fields=["user.email"]
)
```

Kevin: add a one-line table in the docs about defaults: Hosted API default 90 days; Dedicated/Private are tenant-configurable and may be contract-bound. Also add guidance: deterministic hashing (sha256) vs full redaction — note tradeoffs for re-identification.

Sara: legal ACK on the SOC2 phrasing. small edit: change 'pseudonymized: "true"' to a boolean instead of string. add contact line: 'For audit evidence and export procedures, contact support@redwood.com.'

Wanda: updated PR with boolean, defaults note, and contact line. removed any prescriptive KMS instructions (ops should refer to the Private deployment docs).

docs-ci-bot: lint error: code-block-language must be one of (json, bash, python). found unlabeled blocks. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/1402/logs

Wanda: fixing block labels now. will merge after CI passes and legal final ack. thanks! :white_check_mark:
